quotes.text: It was a very special experience to play cello on VSQ Performs Billie Eilish. I really enjoy Billie Eilish as an artist and her music that we translated on this record. It will be so thrilling to play songs from the record on our tour this fall!

It'd be very easy to make string quartet music that is a cliché that people assume when you think of that kind of music–something that's very passive, that people don't engage with in a very intimate and visceral way–and we wanted to make sure that that was not the way that this was done.

We wanted to put something on the stage that still sounds and looks like a string quartet, but feels like you're at a rock or pop show–and that's not just the repertoire. That's the way it's arranged. That's putting incredibly dynamic performers like Derrick on the stage, who's engaging with the music, engaging with the other players, engaging with the audience.
What you want to lean into with everything is, "What do you want to hear?"
I think you're always just approaching this kind of music with a sense of like, "What would I want to hear?"
Vitamin String Quartet is kind of an interesting animal that has lots of shapes and sizes and the people who perform live aren't always the people who are on the recording.
